pdfsign.drop: Drop the contract (PDF) here or click to choose one
pdfsign.label.pad: Draw your signature — with a mouse or a finger
pdfsign.label.preview: Preview — click where the signature should go
pdfsign.status.idle: The document stays in your browser — nothing is uploaded anywhere.
pdfsign.say.drawn: Signature drawn. Now click where it should go in the preview.
pdfsign.err.lib: Could not load the PDF engine
pdfsign.err.libWrite: Could not load the part that writes the PDF
pdfsign.say.spot: Spot set. Sign it and download.
pdfsign.say.opened: Draw your signature, then click where it should go in the preview.
pdfsign.err.noSpot: Click the spot in the preview first.
pdfsign.say.imageUsed: Using that image as the signature. Click the spot in the preview.
